description: This file defines an abstract class 'BaseParam' in the Api\V8\Param namespace. It provides a base implementation for parameter handling, including configuration via Symfony's OptionsResolver, dependency injection of ValidatorFactory and BeanManager, and methods for setting options and serialization.

classes.name: BaseParam
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface and common functionality for API parameter objects, including configuration, validation, and serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BaseParam with ValidatorFactory and BeanManager dependencies.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the parameters based on given arguments, resolving options via Symfony's OptionsResolver.

methods.name: setDefined
methods.description: Method intended to be overridden for defining default options; does nothing in the base class.

methods.name: configureParameters
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to define parameter-specific configuration.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets options by instantiating option classes and applying them to the OptionsResolver.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Returns the parameters as an array for JSON serialization.
